{{Quote|We know now that the Chirq Council is governed by nine members who call themselves the Elite Council. Your next task is simple enough, though quite dangerous: Eliminate the Elite Council.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />}}
'''Braganti Hooge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chirq Council]] [[Elite Council|elite councilor]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Braganti Hooge was one of the nine elite councilors who led the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]]. The eight others were [[Markus Gilder]], [[Zuld Mar-Shayal]], [[Koran Lassk]], [[Janos Zarbo]], [[Mathazar Zayet]], [[Rallyn Secura]], [[Crale Forte]] and [[Atlan Dubreas]]. Hooge was based in the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] decided to infiltrate the organization with a CorSec agent using the identity of [[Trins Evnar]], a Chirq Council member in Doaba Guerfel. After killing Evnar, as well as every other Chirq Council criminals who used to know him,<ref name="SWG:TCCAI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Assumed Identity" on Corellia</ref> the CorSec agent assumed Trins Evnar's identity towards the underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] and managed to lure him, successfully infiltrating the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref> From Jzoro Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their secret headquarters. The Corsec eventually assaulted the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and Second Elite Council Bunkers and killed all elite councilors during the attack. After the death of Braganti Hooge and the other elite councilors, the Chirq Council splintered.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Braganti Hooge was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Braganti Hooge was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
